name: app-assistant-ui-kit-floating-components-on-white
title: Floating assistant components: nav pill, house-shaped chart, greeting card with gradient arc, chips, task cards and settings rows
whatItIs: A white canvas with scattered components: a pill tab bar with a blue selected Home, a house-shaped tile chart in yellow, navy, blue and orange with percentages, a central card 'How can I help you today?' with chips and a gradient arc input, coloured letter avatars, event cards with category tags and letter tiles, toggle chips (Home, Work) and rows for time allocation, frequent activities and mood statistics with round icons.
whatItMeans: Cheerful and organised; a component cloud shows the whole system at once.
techniques: Scatter components on white as a system overview.
Use a house-shaped chart for a family app.
Use round icons on grey rows.

vocabulary.definition: UI parts scattered across a canvas.
A chart shaped like an object such as a house.
A tile with a single letter as an icon.
A pill with a close or switch control.
